{{Top|leg}}
The '''civil service divisions''' were a branch of the bureaucracy of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Their headquarters were located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in a building that [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had modified from a group of business structures. Although the Empire claimed this move was taken for the purposes of thrift and expediency, the true reason was to hide the extensive modifications done to the interior of the structure, changes that were technically illegal under Imperial law. The [[Jenet/Legends|Jenet]] civil servant [[Losh]] was an employee of the civil service divisions.
